Add roles from your LinkedIn saved jobs

Foot Jar cannot reach into LinkedIn on its own, so this is a paste. Thirty seconds.

  1. Open your LinkedIn saved jobs.
  2. Select the whole page with Ctrl A, then copy with Ctrl C. Do each page if you have several.
  3. Paste below and hit Find roles. Anything already tracked is ignored.
